theorems.name: Submission.p03_odd_prepsi_degree_lc_68cf3476
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F) (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → Odd n → (W.preΨ' n).natDegree = (n ^ 2 - 1) / 2 ∧ (W.preΨ' n).leadingCoeff = (n : F)
